categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies ScanForWalletTransactions in src/wallet/wallet.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a silent failure during wallet rescans where transactions are missed and incorrect balances are reported. Descriptor wallet rescans evaluate transactions in block order, causing transactions paying to a key beyond the current look-ahead pool that precede a pool-expanding transaction in the same block to be ignored without warning.
